[h2]The good, the bad, and the… boring.[/h2]

So, at first, I was totally hooked. The game looks amazing, super flashy and cyberpunk, and the fighting is actually really fun. Like, for the first 30 seconds of a fight, you feel like a total badass, just mowing down robots with these insane powers. It’s got that instant gratification thing down, you know?

But then… you keep playing. And it’s like, the same thing. Over. And over. And over again. You’re just in the same two places, fighting the same couple of bosses, doing the same boring tasks. It's like they spent all their energy on making the game look cool and forgot to, like, actually make it fun to play for more than five minutes.

[b]The Grind is Real (and Not in a Good Way)[/b]

And don't even get me started on the whole “meta-progression” thing. It’s this super confusing grid system that you have to fill with these Tetris-like blocks to make your character stronger. It’s supposed to be this deep, strategic thing, but honestly, it just feels like they’re trying to make the game confusing on purpose to hide the fact that there’s nothing to do. It's a total grind, and not the fun kind. It feels like homework.

[b]Literally Unplayable[/b]

Oh, and the bugs! The game has this insane stuttering issue that freezes the screen for a few seconds at a time. It’s been a problem since the beta, and they still haven’t fixed it. Like, hello? It’s a fast-paced shooter, you can’t just have the game freeze in the middle of a fight. It's so frustrating.

And for a game that’s supposed to be all about playing with your friends, the multiplayer is a total mess. The matchmaking doesn’t work, and when you finally do get into a group, it’s super laggy. So you just end up playing by yourself anyway. Lame.

[b]The Verdict? Save Your Time (and Money)[/b]

Honestly, Terminull Brigade is a huge letdown. It’s all style and no substance. It looks pretty, but it’s a buggy, repetitive mess with basically no content. And the fact that they want you to spend real money on it is just insulting.

So, yeah. Hard pass. There are so many other games out there that are actually worth your time. Don't waste it on this one.

It’s what I’d call a third person Roguelite  game. The game looks good, and there’s monetization. Of course the game is free to play, so they have to make some income. 

The characters each have their own distinct playstyle. Each skill feels different, but somehow generic.

The matchmaking is busted because there are so many different difficulty levels, with not enough players to support.  If you have friends then in n suggest partying up.

What’s BAD, is the stuttering in the performance of the game.  It happens randomly and sometimes often.  The worst of times is during boss fights, and on harder difficulties , where enemies deal more damage and you aren’t able to react appropriately. 

Dodging seems to be more of a gamble than a skill issue. When bosses telegraph their moves, you time you dodge correctly, but some how the bosses have pinpoint accuracy in spite of dodging.

The game has potential to be great, it just needs more players and the strutting needs to be addressed post haste.

While most claim that the monetization is problematic, I never experienced that. Over half of the cast of playable characters are given to you within the first couple hours of play, and only the newest one seems to have a heavy grind to unlock.

The real issue with this game is that it is stimulating in so many ways, colors, currencies, flashing lights, banging music, cool character designs... but it's just hollow. There's so little to actually do in the game, and you are asked to do it over and over. Not to mention the absolute mess that is the story, the one thing that could maybe keep you engaged.

Basically, if running the same pretty level over and over again sounds fun, then you might like this. Worth a download just to play the 2 different levels once each, but you probably won't get too much more fun out of it.
